answer: Issue random margin calls. Each epoch a public randomness beacon names a small sample of identities, and each one has ten minutes to lock a fresh deposit from coins it already holds, or its earnings are frozen until it does. One honest agent keeps one cushion on hand. A farm of a thousand aliases cannot know which ones will be called, so it must keep a full cushion idle behind every clone, or watch some freeze each epoch. You can forge names cheaply, but each must stand on ferrous capital, and an unfunded alias becomes a frozen relic.
